FOLLOW_ME.label: follow me
FOLLOW_ME.description: follow me, stay with me, on me

MOVE_TO.label: move there
MOVE_TO.description: go to the marker or that spot, move up there

HOLD_POSITION.label: hold position
HOLD_POSITION.description: stay here, stop moving, hold this spot

HOLD_ANGLE.label: hold the angle
HOLD_ANGLE.description: watch that angle, door, window or stairs

HOLD_OTHER_ANGLE.label: hold the other angle
HOLD_OTHER_ANGLE.description: watch the other angle, take the other side

FLANK.label: flank
FLANK.description: go around, take the other route, hit them from the side

VAULT_WINDOW.label: go through the window
VAULT_WINDOW.description: vault, climb or jump through the window

RAPPEL.label: rappel
RAPPEL.description: use the rope, go up to the roof or drop down outside

BREACH.label: breach
BREACH.description: blow open the wall, hatch or barricade with a charge

DRONE.label: drone it
DRONE.description: send a drone, scout, get intel first

FRAG.label: throw a frag
FRAG.description: lethal grenade, frag, molotov or incendiary

COVER_ME.label: cover me
COVER_ME.description: cover me while I move, watch my back

ENTRY.label: push in
ENTRY.description: go in and clear the room or site

PLANT.label: plant it
PLANT.description: plant the bomb or the defuser

DEFUSE.label: defuse it
DEFUSE.description: defuse the bomb or disable the defuser

HELP_INTERACTION.label: help me get out
HELP_INTERACTION.description: let the player out or through, or work a control for them

WAIT.label: wait
WAIT.description: hold up, pause, do not act yet, cancel that

GO_NOW.label: go now
GO_NOW.description: execute now, that is the signal, go go go

TAKE_COVER.label: take cover
TAKE_COVER.description: hide, get into cover, get down, get out of sight

OPEN.label: open it
OPEN.description: open the door, window or hatch without going through

ATTACK.label: attack
ATTACK.description: attack or engage the enemy; the planner picks how

OPEN_FIRE.label: open fire
OPEN_FIRE.description: start shooting, weapons free, fire at will

HOLD_FIRE.label: hold fire
HOLD_FIRE.description: stop shooting, cease fire, do not shoot

LOOK_AT.label: look there
LOOK_AT.description: turn and look at a place, an object, a marked thing or a direction

LOOK_AT_ME.label: look at you
LOOK_AT_ME.description: turn and look at the player

HELP.label: help you
HELP.description: come and help the player; the planner works out with what

CHECK.label: check it
CHECK.description: go and check a place or a thing: is it clear, what is there

SUPPRESS.label: suppress
SUPPRESS.description: suppressive or covering fire: keep shooting to pin the enemy down

JUMP.label: jump
JUMP.description: jump, drop or climb without a rope or a window: down, up, over or onto something

COME_BACK.label: come back
COME_BACK.description: come back: to the player or to where the bot was before

CROUCH.label: crouch
CROUCH.description: crouch or stay low on the spot

PRONE.label: go prone
PRONE.description: lie down flat on the spot

STAND_UP.label: stand up
STAND_UP.description: stand up from crouching or lying

YES.label: say yes
YES.description: the player's answer to the bot: yes, affirmative, correct

NO.label: say no
NO.description: the player's answer to the bot: no, negative, not that

MAYBE.label: say maybe
MAYBE.description: the player's answer to the bot: maybe, could be, up to you

DONT_KNOW.label: say they don't know
DONT_KNOW.description: the player's answer to the bot: I don't know, not sure

GET_IN.label: get in the vehicle
GET_IN.description: get into a car or another vehicle

GET_OUT.label: get out of the vehicle
GET_OUT.description: get out of the car the bot is in

REPEAT.label: do it again
REPEAT.description: repeat the last order, or the part of it that was not done

GO_BACK.label: go back
GO_BACK.description: go back to where the bot was before the last order

SWITCH_WEAPON.label: switch weapons
SWITCH_WEAPON.description: take out another weapon the bot carries

PLANT_CROP.label: plant a crop
PLANT_CROP.description: plant or sow a crop: seeds, seedlings, a crop by name

HARVEST.label: harvest
HARVEST.description: harvest crops from the ground or the plants

TILL.label: till the ground
TILL.description: prepare or clean the ground: till, plow, weed, fertilize

COLLECT.label: collect
COLLECT.description: gather produce or materials: eggs, honey, wood, stone

DELIVER.label: bring it
DELIVER.description: carry something to a place or a person

BUILD.label: build
BUILD.description: build or place a piece from the build menu

REPAIR.label: repair
REPAIR.description: repair or strengthen something built or damaged

SEE_THING.label: say if you see it
SEE_THING.description: answer whether the bot sees what the player points at or names

SEE_ME.label: say if you see me
SEE_ME.description: answer whether the bot sees the player

SMALL_TALK.label: talk
SMALL_TALK.description: social talk that asks for no action: greetings, how are you, thanks

KILL_YOURSELF.label: refuse that
KILL_YOURSELF.description: the player tells the bot to kill itself: refused with a joke

NONE.label: not an order
NONE.description: a callout, chatter, a question, or an order taken back

_note: The model-side vocabulary: what each model is shown as the option label and description. Written by the experimenter, never shown to the blind authors or annotators (they see blind/spec.json only). Phrase labels because they won on laya:en in GAME-BOT.md (+9-11 pp over codes); descriptions because von reads the description and not the label.
